title: Integration Of States
definition: The process of merging 565 Princely States into the Indian Union post-Independence (1947-1950), orchestrated by the States Department under Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel and V.P. Menon.
importanceInUpsc: Essential for understanding the consolidation of India's territorial integrity, federal structure, and the evolution of the Indian Constitution.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Integration Of States.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
